query:
SELECT
            (ct.hidden OR COALESCE(c.hidden, FALSE)) AS "hidden!",
            ct.team_id AS "team_id!",
            tu.team_role AS "role!: TeamRole"
        FROM crm_contacts ct
        LEFT JOIN crm_companies c
            ON c.id = ct.company_id
        JOIN team_user tu
            ON tu.team_id = ct.team_id
           AND tu.user_id = $1
        WHERE ct.id = $2
